name: MarineMax, Inc.
tagline: World's largest recreational boat and yacht retailer, marina operator, and superyacht services company.
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu total reflète l'ampleur des opérations de MarineMax en tant que plus grand détaillant mondial de bateaux de plaisance et opérateur de marinas, englobant les ventes de bateaux neufs et d'occasion, les services connexes et les activités de marinas.

kpis.explanation: Total sales revenue from new and used boat sales, marine products, repair and maintenance services, marina operations, and superyacht services.
kpis.signal: Global market leader in recreational boating retail.
kpis.description: Represents the total business volume of the company, including boat sales, parts, accessories, marina operations, and yacht services.

kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, before deduction of other operating expenses.
kpis.description: Indicates the direct profitability of product and service sales.

kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue, measuring the profitability of core operations.
kpis.description: Reflects the company's efficiency in managing operating costs to generate profits.

kpis.explanation: Capital investments in digital platforms, technology development, and product innovation initiatives.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation through digital transformation and technology platforms such as Boatyard and Boatzon.

kpis.explanation: Total capital spending on property, plant, equipment, marina facilities, and acquisitions.
kpis.description: Measures investments in long-term assets such as retail locations, marinas, and infrastructure.

kpis.explanation: Total number of employees across all retail locations, marinas, manufacturing facilities, and service operations.
kpis.description: Indicator of organization size and workforce requirements across 120+ worldwide locations.

ai_positioning.summary: MarineMax does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K filing. Technology investments focus on digital customer experience platforms (Boatyard, Boatzon) rather than AI.

risks.title: Brunswick Manufacturer Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on Brunswick for new boat sales, representing approximately 18% of revenue in fiscal 2025. Disruption of this relationship could significantly impact business operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Strong reliance on Brunswick as a key supplier makes the company vulnerable to changes in the manufacturing relationship or supply disruptions.

risks.title: Increased Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: The recreational boating market is highly competitive with numerous market participants. Intensifying competition could result in price pressures and margin compression. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Growing competition in the recreational boating market may negatively impact sales volumes and profit margins.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed multiple acquisitions in recent years, including IGY Marinas, Cruisers Yachts, and other strategic purchases. Integration challenges, asset impairment, and goodwill write-downs pose financial risks. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Multiple recent acquisitions carry integration risks including operational complexity, potential asset impairment, and overpayment exposure.

risks.title: Economic Cycle Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company's business is highly dependent on economic conditions and consumer discretionary spending. Economic recession would significantly impact recreational boat sales. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Business performance is strongly tied to overall economic health and consumer confidence, creating vulnerability to economic downturns.

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company operates under marine and environmental regulations. Non-compliance could result in penalties and operational restrictions. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Exposure to governmental and environmental regulations carries compliance costs and potential financial penalties.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates digital platforms (Boatyard, Boatzon, Boatzon marketplace) and customer-facing systems. Cybersecurity breaches could compromise customer data and disrupt operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Digital platform operations expose the company to cybersecurity threats, data breaches, and operational disruptions.

risks.title: Reputation and Service Quality Risks
risks.score_rationale: As the market leader in recreational boating retail, the company faces elevated reputational risks from product quality issues, customer service failures, or litigation. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: High market visibility and customer-centric positioning create significant reputational risks that could impact brand value and sales.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
